basic_info.description: Life at the crossroads of NOPA, Alamo Square, and the Panhandle means mornings start with coffee from The Mill, sunsets under Golden Gate Park's trees, and impromptu picnics at Alamo Square with By-Rite goodies. Laid-back nights at 4505 BBQ, date nights at Che Fico or Nopa, live shows at The Independent, and arcade nostalgia at The Emporium. And at home, it's all waitingyour own private entry and the kind of ground-floor ease that makes life seamless. Morning coffee on your deeded patio, quick trips out with your pup, or unloading farmers market finds without a single stair. Inside: white oak floors, recessed lighting, and an open layout designed for modern living. The updated kitchen features stainless steel appliances, gas range, and breakfast bar. Two spacious bedrooms include one with a cozy gas fireplace and a bonus nook ideal for a quiet retreat or work-from-home space, while both renovated bathrooms shine with spa-inspired finishes and a double vanity. Outdoor living continues with access to a sunny shared deck and sidewalk garden. With a Walk Score of 97, a Bike Score of 93, and a Transit Score of 82, the city is at your door. Leased parking is available for $295/month, with a 6-month seller credit. Transparent pricing for a straightforward path to home.
